mapping_json.fidelity_notes: BLEED-DOT GLADIATOR. Physical rule: element-neutral on both slots; identity expressed via melee_arc + bleed (stack-additive native). 'Hit once, watch them bleed out' -> PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_uptime (DoT-uptime identity, s5 route); Gratuitous Violence 'bleeding enemies explode on kill for 20% max life' -> GEOMETRY_PROPAGATION_cascade (s5 on-kill propagation row, exact). PHASE_MOMENTUM considered for the stance pair and REJECTED: the build PARKS in a stance per room rather than cycling stances for momentum -- doors express identity, not everything plausible (R-M1); the toggle lands as self_buff + activation-toggle instead. The dual-slash overlap double-hit is a composite sub-geometry melee_arc does not enumerate (noted). Max-block is the archetype's defense half -- def-bin territory (deflect rider), outside skill-mapping lanes, recorded in scaffold. Era note: verify_ledger era claim UNSUPPORTED (no anchor for the 3-span stamp); identity+mechanics CONFIRMED -- mapping rests on mechanics.
